visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a large Chipmunk mascot head filling the entire screen. A young woman with blonde hair, wearing a brown sweater and a brown pleated skirt, pulls the large plush head away to reveal her smiling face. She is situated in a well-lit indoor room with light-colored wooden walls and a bed in the background. (2) A rapid montage sequence follows, showing the woman in various poses and outfits, including a brown long-sleeved top and a white tank top with a white skirt. She interactively showcases a wide variety of Disney-themed merchandise, such as Chip 'n Dale hats, Mickey Mouse bags, and patterned suitcases. The camera is mostly static but the cuts are extremely fast, matching the upbeat rhythm. (3) The woman sits on the floor to provide a detailed look at a reversible bucket hat, turning it inside out to show the different patterns. She holds up small items like keychains and a coin purse shaped like a hat. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the textures of the plush toys and fabrics. (4) The final phase shows her demonstrating a plush toy that unzips to become a neck pillow, which she wears around her neck. She poses with a collection of Mickey and Chip 'n Dale luggage and accessories, including a utility vest and phone charms. Her expressions remain highly energetic and engaging as she points to the various branded products.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with a high-energy pop track featuring a driving 128 BPM electronic beat and female vocals. A sharp transition sound effect marks the shift from the musical intro to the main content. (2) A female speaker enters with a highly animated and energetic tone in Traditional Chinese. Her speech rate is fast and rhythmic, punctuated by occasional short pauses for emphasis. The background music continues at a consistent volume. (3) As each new product is revealed visually, stylized sound effects such as bubbly pops and clear dings are inserted to draw attention to the items. These SFX are crisp and have high frequency brightness. (4) The audio concludes with a brief call to action delivered with rising intonation, accompanied by a final musical flourish and a synthesized chime that fades out alongside the BGM.
